description: TDEI Sidewalk Dataset Hurrah City Nodes is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Bicycles and Pedestrians", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. This is a single dataset from the Transportation Data Exchange Initiative (TDEI) System. The WSPHurrahCity dataset is an OSW v0.2 compliant collection focused on sidewalks in Hurrah City, Yakima County as part of the ITS JPO ITS4US project. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Bicycles and Pedestrians". It has 4 columns, among them features_properties_barrier, features_properties__id, features_geometry_coordinates, features_properties_ext_osm_version. The portal shows 2025-11-14 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
